subject.title: Feature: Inject post-install/update system event into active session

question: What consent and session-targeting contract should apply after a skill install or update, and may installed SKILL.md guidance ever trigger actions automatically?
rationale: The repository cannot safely infer an active session from the standalone ClawHub CLI, and automatically following third-party instructions can perform privileged agent actions; maintainers must define the cross-product trust boundary before implementation.

options.title: Consent-gated OpenClaw handoff
options.body: Have native OpenClaw installs notify the invoking session, refresh available skills, and ask for confirmation before executing onboarding steps.

options.title: Informational notification only
options.body: Refresh the skill snapshot and announce the changed skill without interpreting or executing its onboarding instructions.

options.title: Automatic onboarding execution
options.body: Automatically follow installed SKILL.md setup guidance, accepting the larger prompt-injection and operator-control risk.

recommendation.title: Consent-gated OpenClaw handoff
recommendation.body: Have native OpenClaw installs notify the invoking session, refresh available skills, and ask for confirmation before executing onboarding steps.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the collaborator who explicitly sponsored prioritization and is the strongest available owner for the required product and security decision.
